title: The isomorphism locus in an affine finite free frame is principal
statement: Let W be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let M,N be sheaves of modules on W [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let φ:M→N. Let U be an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Suppose I,J are finite sets and the ordinary restrictions of M,N to U are isomorphic to the free structure modules indexed by I,J. Then there exists f∈Γ(U,𝒪_W) such that U∩U_φ=D_U(f), where U_φ is the neighbourhood-defined locally invertible open [def-sc-module-map-iso-locus]. No equality of the two ranks is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 10.79.4(3), local matrix argument; Tag 0BDP final determinant sentence

proof.text: Enumerate the finite frame index types. In equal ranks the restriction of the morphism is a square matrix of sections on U. Take f to be its determinant. Restriction carries this matrix to the matrix on each smaller open. On D(f) the determinant is a unit, so the adjugate matrix divided by f gives an inverse. Tensor pullback along open inclusions and ordinary restriction are naturally isomorphic by uniqueness of left adjoints to module pushforward. Hence D(f) is contained in U intersect the neighbourhood-defined isomorphism locus.

Conversely, a point in U intersect the locus has an inverse on some neighbourhood. Intersect that neighbourhood with U and take the stalk: the transported matrices are inverse. The determinant is therefore a unit in the local ring, precisely the condition for membership in D(f). This proves the equality in equal ranks, including rank zero with determinant 1.

For unequal ranks take f=0. If a point were in the intersection, the neighbourhood inverse would induce an isomorphism on residue-field vector spaces of dimensions card I and card J. Their dimensions must agree, a contradiction. Thus both sides are empty. An empty U has no points and satisfies the equality as well.

theorem moduleMapIsoLocus_inter_eq_basicOpen_of_free {W : Scheme.{u}}
    {M N : W.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {I J : Type u} [Finite I] [Finite J]
    (eM : M.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.free I)
    (eN : N.restrict U.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.free J) :
    ∃ f : W.presheaf.obj (.op U),
      (U : Set W) ∩ (moduleMapIsoLocus φ : Set W) = (W.basicOpen f : Set W)
